notes.title: First public Playtest
notes.content:
[h3]This moment could not be held for any longer.[/h3]
The team has been working hard the past half a year on getting the development process to be shared with you. 

All allowed for the playtest can freely share their experiences with other fellow players on every available social media platform. Players who registered for it before the announcement, have received the access by now. Check your email, if you registered for the playtest before. 

[b]PLAYTEST IS OPEN FOR EVERYONE UNTIL JUNE 1st 2021. [/b]
After that, it will return on a registration basis.

Developers will join in the discussion of the features and bugs in social media such as:
[list]
[*][url=https://discord.gg/PvJfeuUQ8G]Discord[/url]
[*][url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Knitted_TheGame/]Reddit[/url]
[*][url=https://vk.com/knitted_and_inflatable]VK[/url]
[/list]

Some warm feedback will be appreciated :)

notes.title: Playtest sign-up is live!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Playtest sign-up is live![/b][/h1]

Hello, Knitted Adventureres! Do you want to make a change in the development process of Knitted and Inflatable? Well now there is a wonderful chance to do it and proudly call yourself a "[b]tester[/b]"! ːsteamhappyː

[b]Take a peak in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1324840/Knitted_And_Inflatable/]games store page[/url] and sign-up for upcoming playtest of the game![/b]

You will recieve the notification via email when the access will be granted to you and the playtest version will appear in your Steam Library.
